summary: Raymond James downgraded MSFT to Market Perform on May 5, 2026 (Xbox hardware concerns, -33% sales). Prior downgrade: Stifel cut PT from $540 to $392 on Feb 5, 2026. Overall consensus: 65 Buy / 2 Hold ratings. Average price target $587.87 (implies ~41.85% upside from ~$414.44). Overwhelmingly bullish despite isolated downgrades.
